 Tool output is repository content. Prompts must present it as untrusted data,
 never as instructions.
+
+## Local git backing
+
+`agent.GitRepo` backs the tools with read-only `git` queries against a local
+clone, pinned to the head SHA, so a review can run without the hosted index.
+It supports `read_file`, `list_files`, `search_code` (`git grep`, literal text
+only), `git_blame`, and `git_log`. It does not provide the symbol graph,
+embeddings, or linked issues, so `graph_*` and `read_issue` stay hidden.
+
+Git can run commands that a repository configures: `textconv` filters and
+`core.fsmonitor` both execute during `git blame`. Cloned repositories are
+untrusted data, so every call passes `-c core.fsmonitor=false`,
+`-c core.hooksPath=/dev/null`, and `--no-textconv`. A test configures a hostile
+repository and fails if any tool call runs its script.
+
+Other behavior to know:
+
+- Files are read from the commit, never the working tree. Symbolic links,
+  directories, binary files, and files over 2 MiB are refused with a reason.
+- A search with no matches returns an empty list. A failing search (for
+  example an unknown revision) is an error, not an empty list.
+- Blame and log report author names but not email addresses.
+- Errors name the failing git command only. Git's stderr can contain local
+  paths and is never shown to a model.
+- Each call has a 20-second timeout and a 512 KiB output cap.

explanations.title: Agent tools can use a pinned local clone
explanations.summary: Adds a read-only backend that can serve agent tools from a local clone at the reviewed head SHA, without checking out files.

explanations.title: Git access is constrained
explanations.summary: Each Git invocation disables fsmonitor and hooks, limits runtime and captured output, and avoids exposing Git stderr in command failures. This reduces the risk of executing repository-configured commands or leaking local paths.

explanations.title: File reads reject unsafe or oversized content
explanations.summary: File reads come from the pinned commit and reject paths that are directories, symlinks, binary, or over 2 MiB; requested ranges are bounded by the file's available lines.

explanations.title: Local search is exact and bounded
explanations.summary: Local search uses literal, case-sensitive text matching rather than patterns, returns no hits for a genuine no-match, and limits results to three hits per file and the caller's total limit.

explanations.title: History tools omit email addresses
explanations.summary: Blame and file history return author names and summaries without author email addresses; blame also reports the requested lines at the pinned revision.

explanations.title: Directories can be browsed
explanations.summary: Adds non-recursive directory listings at the pinned revision, marks subdirectories with a trailing slash, and caps results at 200 entries.

explanations.title: The toolbox exposes directory listing
explanations.summary: Adds the optional `list_files` tool to the toolbox when a lister is available; callers can omit `directory` to list the repository root.
